what: Where an autonomous HCLI science round's wall actually goes, from the round's own receipt

measurement_contract.path: the engine's agentic tool loop, 6 model calls in one round
measurement_contract.not_a_benchmark: these are the round's OWN production calls, not a synthetic workload
measurement_contract.nr: native-packed sealed-3.14, physical_ebpw 3.1393, artifact ~9.9 GB at /Users/scammermike/noetic/NOETIC_PARENT_A

findings: PREFILL RUNS AT DECODE SPEED. 15,987 prompt tokens took 587.0 s = 27.24 tok/s. The sealed qualification path measures decode at 24.41 TPS. Prefill is 1.12x decode, not the order of magnitude a batched prefill would give. The receipt's own attribution says it plainly: prompt tokens are being paid for at decode prices.
PREFILL IS 93.1% OF THE ROUND. 587.0 s of 630.6 s of model wall, to produce 681 output tokens. The round read 23.5 prompt tokens for every token it generated.
IT IS NOT HOST BOUND. GPU is 97.0% of prefill wall; host control is 1.4-2.3% per call. Nothing here is fixed by making the Python faster.

580 DISPATCHES PER TOKEN, 9.06 per layer, identical on every call and every position bucket. 9,272,460 dispatches for one round. Per-layer dispatch count is already tight, so cutting kernels buys little; stepping N tokens together is what divides it.
COST RISES WITH POSITION, 1.34x-2.29x from first to last bucket within a single call, which implicates full attention over a growing KV rather than a flat per-token cost.

THE PREFIX CACHE MISSES. Only 2,514 of 15,987 prompt tokens were reused: 15.7%. Two of six calls report checkpoint_missed with a real shared prefix (834 and 609 tokens) and went fully cold anyway, costing 42.8 s = 7.3% of prefill wall.

cheapest_levers_in_order.why: two calls shared a prefix and still prefilled from zero; this is above the Metal layer
calls 3 and 4 reused 2,514 of 7,473 prompt tokens; the rest was re-prefilled

the remaining ~84%. Turns per-layer GEMV into one GEMM and divides the dispatch count by N. Cost: the recurrent state must advance chunk-wise rather than per position. This is a Metal change and should follow the two cheap ones.

cannot_settle: WHICH KERNEL. The rising-with-position shape narrows the field to attention over a growing KV, but only a per-kernel trace (HAWKING_TRACE_DISPATCH=1) attributes the growth to GQA attention vs DeltaNet vs the MLP GEMMs. The discriminator: DeltaNet and the MLP must stay FLAT across position buckets if this is attention.
honest_limit: One round, six calls. The per-call spread of prefill rate is 22.6-36.6 tok/s, so the 27.24 aggregate carries a real spread and is not a three-digit number.
